column2: Table related to the selection of the events from MaPSy T0 to T1,2,3,4

The calculations in the different columns correspond to:
dPSI_H_G =  |(HIGH-GFP)MaPSy - (HIGH -GFP)endogenous|
dPSI_H_G+PSI_G = dPSI_H_G + GFPMaPsy 
Response = HIGHMaPsy - GFPMaPsy 
lack_of_L = LOWMaPsy - GFPMaPsy
double_res = Response + lack_of_L
doble+2G = double_res - 2 * GFPMaPsy
dob+2G+dP = (doble+2G)-|(HIGH -GFP)endogenous - (HIGH-GFP)MaPSy|
